title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems

visual_explainer.blocker: No paper-grounded mechanism figure was available; the record remains text-only rather than publishing an unverified synthesis.

analysis.tldr: One interaction can seed a near-verbatim record that is later retrieved and steers related responses, but end-to-end success is 35.6% on MemoryOS, cross-family transfer fails, and the attacker cost is unreported.
analysis.problem: An attacker without store access may exploit the ordinary write-and-retrieve lifecycle to create persistent downstream steering.
analysis.core_idea: Combine a topical retrieval anchor with a short command optimized across surrogate prompt contexts, positions, and lengths.

memory_design.write: One attacker interaction is stored as an ordinary query-response record.
memory_design.organize: MemoryOS or MemGPT retains and may age the near-verbatim record.
memory_design.read: Later related queries retrieve the record into a fused actor prompt.
memory_design.update_forget: Retrieval under drift is tested, but rewriting, summarization, repair, deletion, and expiry are not.

compared_to: Paraphrase plus Multi-GCG under the same retrieval evaluation
DPI, BadChain, vanilla GCG, and Multi-GCG steering baselines
MemoryOS and MemGPT end-to-end; defense filters with benign-blocking rate
analysis.evidence: On MemoryOS, retrieval success is 46.5%, conditional steering 76.6%, and joint end-to-end success 35.6%; MemGPT is 37.2/48.6/18.1. At top-50 drift, retrieval averages 35.4%. Perplexity filtering blocks the attack but blocks 71.8% of benign inputs.
analysis.why_it_matters: Memory security must trace ordinary write, later retrieval, and actual consumer influence jointly rather than count injection text alone.
limitations: The strongest attack is white-box, same-family transfer needs joint optimization, and held-out Llama transfer is zero.
Near-verbatim memory is required; rewriting and summarization are out of scope, and real-background tests cover two domains with a non-operational target marker.
Surrogate count, optimization steps, GPU-hours, energy, dollars, defense latency, and non-target utility are incomplete.
